headline: Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar has left for Istanbul to attend the first-ever meeting of R-4 (Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkiye) and E-3 (France, UK, Germany) foreign ministers on 23 October, hosted by Turkiye's Hakan Fidan.

card.desc: Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkiye meet France, UK, Germany.

caption:
Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar has left for Istanbul for the first-ever meeting of R-4 and E-3 foreign ministers, Dawn reports. Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye will meet France, the UK and Germany at Turkiye's invitation, Express Tribune adds.
